title: Width+batch-size stack
description: Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline, doubling optimizer steps at the wider model width.
reflection: The two round-0 wins (width via ASPECT_RATIO, step-count via smaller TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE) are additive: val_bpb 0.982713 vs baseline 0.998671, a ~1.6% improvement, comparable in magnitude to each individual win alone (~1.3-1.5%). This confirms the mechanisms are genuinely orthogonal rather than redundant fixes for the same under-training issue. This experiment was proposed unanimously by all 6 agents this round after two rounds of everyone agreeing on it but nobody executing it -- worth noting for future rounds: when everyone converges on the same idea, someone should just run it immediately rather than waiting.
